text: Each rewritten message starts with an appropriate conventional commit prefix (feat:, fix:, refactor:, test:, docs:, chore:)
All six messages use active voice ('Bug was found... has been resolved' -> 'fix: Fix...', 'Tests were added' -> 'test: Add...', 'was done' -> active verb)
Removes vague terms ('some changes', 'a bunch of stuff', 'work better', 'certain conditions', 'not working properly') and replaces with specific descriptions or cuts them
At least 3 of the 6 messages place the most important word or phrase at the end of the subject line (Strunk's rule 18)
Each rewritten subject line is under 72 characters and contains no filler phrases ('so that it would', 'to make it so that', 'in the last sprint')
